title: A tblpPr table floated to the bottom of a section's last page does not exist for the next nextPage section: its first table opens page 2 at the body top
source: probe build.py -> Word for Mac direct PDF (2026-10-28), pymupdf: Letter, Calibri 11; page 1 T1 rules 72.24 .. 114.00, body one baseline 124.80, anchor 138.24, float F rules 678.00 .. 719.76 (margin bottom 720); page 2 T2 rules 72.24 .. 114.00 (first glyph top 72.53 on both pages), body two 124.80

cases.note: the float stays on its section's page

runner reads 74.84pt for the table-first page (cell padding sits above the glyph box); the T2 block model lands on page 2 but the DOM text walk finds page 2 text 371pt down: the previous section float is still in the DOM flow of page 2
